name: @local/main
description: App-local main composition and glue scaffold.

ownershipGuidance.title: App-local main lane
ownershipGuidance.summary: Keep @local/main focused on app composition and lightweight glue. Substantial server features should become dedicated packages instead of growing inside packages/main.
responsibilities: packages/main server code: app-local composition and lightweight wiring only
substantial non-CRUD server features: scaffold a dedicated package with feature-server-generator
packages/main: do not add service/controller/route/repository feature trees here
examples: npx jskit generate feature-server-generator scaffold booking-engine
npx jskit generate feature-server-generator scaffold availability-engine --mode orchestrator
